title: OpenAR Skill Hub entry
description: One directory record per skill under entries/skills/<id>/entry.json. scripts/validate.py is the authoritative checker for CI; this schema documents the same contract.

id.description: Namespaced identity, e.g. openra.diagram-design. Separate from the display name; globally unique; never reused.

name.description: One short English name, identical in every language.

summaryI18n.description: Optional translations of the summary only.

github.description: GitHub login without '@', when the author has one.

authors.description: Original creators of the skill, distinct from the OpenAR adapter and the registry submitter. Verified against the source repo's commits, license, or README during review.

maintainers.description: GitHub logins currently maintaining the skill.

adapters.description: GitHub logins of the people who adapted the skill for OpenAR. Adapting is not authorship.

registrySubmitter.description: GitHub login of whoever submitted this entry. The submitter is not an author by default.

categories.description: Coarse categories, e.g. writing, diagrams, data.

path.description: Subdirectory of the skill inside the repo. Use "." for the repo root. A URL never installs a whole repository by itself.

revision.description: Exact 40-hex commit SHA. main/latest/mutable tags are discovery hints only, never a pin.

repo.description: owner/name of the repo this entry's content derives from.

revision.description: Exact 40-hex upstream commit the adaptation started from.

path.description: Subdirectory of the skill inside the upstream repo, when not the root.

license.description: SPDX id of the upstream license.

upstream.description: Structured provenance of an adaptation. Required when adapters is non-empty; original maintainer-authored content hosted on this hub, and entries whose source already points at the upstream, do not need it. Summaries are display text; provenance lives here, not in the prose.

version.description: Upstream-reported version; the pinned revision when upstream reports none.

license.description: SPDX identifier of the entry's license, e.g. MIT.

licenseFile.description: Path of the license text inside the entry directory, e.g. LICENSE. Required when the license is not machine-readable from upstream.

reviewedRevision.description: The exact revision the review covered. Reviewing one revision never vouches for later ones.

harnesses.description: Harnesses the skill is known to work with. Empty means unspecified, not all.

delivery.description: hub: installable at the pinned revision. Built-in OpenAR skills are never listed on this hub.

path.description: Relative to the skill root (source.path). No '..', no absolute paths.

files.description: Complete manifest of the skill's necessary files with pinned hashes. Only the skill's own scripts/references/assets; directories that do not exist are not listed.

totalBytes.description: Sum of files[].bytes. Per-entry cap: 2 MiB.

requires.description: Ids of extensions/CLI/MCP this skill depends on. Declared only; installing them is never automatic.

permissionsNote.description: Note that allowed-tools or similar declarations inside SKILL.md are claims, not host approvals.
